kpis.description_fr: Ventes nettes FY25 ($1.82Md, -1.3Md YoY). Spikevax + mNEXSPIKE COVID + mResvia RSV. Déclin endémique post-pandémie.
kpis.description_en: FY25 net product sales ($1.82Bn, -$1.3Bn YoY). Spikevax + mNEXSPIKE COVID + mResvia RSV. Post-pandemic endemic decline.

kpis.description_fr: Programmes cliniques actifs FY25 (35 dont 25 development candidates). Oncologie individualisée, latent virus CMV, influenza, rare disease. Diversification post-COVID.
kpis.description_en: FY25 active clinical programs (35, 25 development candidates). Individualized oncology, CMV, flu, rare disease. Post-COVID diversification.

kpis.description_fr: Cash + investments FY25 ($8.1Md). Burn rate élevé pendant pivot pipeline, runway annoncé 4 ans.
kpis.description_en: FY25 cash + investments ($8.1Bn). High burn rate during pipeline pivot, 4-year runway announced.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu différé FY25 ($107M, dont $42M produits). Reflète décélération commandes gouvernementales COVID/RSV.
kpis.description_en: FY25 deferred revenue ($107M, of which $42M product). Reflects decelerating government COVID/RSV orders.

kpis.description_fr: Programmes en Phase 3 / approuvés FY25 (Spikevax, mNEXSPIKE, mResvia, mRNA-4157 melanoma, mRNA-1647 CMV, mRNA-1010 flu). Progression vers diversification revenue.
kpis.description_en: FY25 Phase 3 / approved programs (Spikevax, mNEXSPIKE, mResvia, mRNA-4157 melanoma, mRNA-1647 CMV, mRNA-1010 flu). Path to revenue diversification.

kpis_story.description_fr: mRNA-4157 (V940) : vaccin cancer individualisé melanoma adjuvant + Keytruda. Phase 3 INTerpath en cours, BLA cible 2026. Pari haut potentiel.
kpis_story.description_en: mRNA-4157 (V940): individualized melanoma cancer adjuvant vaccine + Keytruda. Phase 3 INTerpath ongoing, BLA target 2026. High-potential bet.

kpis_story.description_fr: mRNA-1647 : vaccin CMV (cytomegalovirus). Phase 3 CMVictory readout attendu 2025-2026. Pas de vaccin CMV existant, marché vierge.
kpis_story.description_en: mRNA-1647: CMV vaccine. Phase 3 CMVictory readout expected 2025-2026. No existing CMV vaccine, greenfield market.

_notes: Moderna = mRNA platform. Pivot post-COVID vers oncology + latent virus + rare disease. Source: 10-K FY25 filed Feb 2026. Added Deferred Revenue + Phase 3 count to reach 5 specific KPIs.
